nodes.label: VRAM LRU Policy & Workbox 3d-models-cache Expansion
nodes.rationale: Retains shared small assets in AssetRepository while allowing evictRegion() on heavy park.glb, and recommends raising Workbox maxEntries from 50 to 150-200 so ~180 prefabs do not evict primary maps offline.

nodes.label: Pivot Alignment (Y=0 Base) & Normal Matrix Baking
nodes.norm_label: pivot alignment (y=0 base) & normal matrix baking
nodes.rationale: Bakes worldMatrix into POSITION shifted by (-centerX, -bottomY, -centerZ), transforms NORMAL by normalMatrix with unit normalization, and resets root node transforms to identity so procedural placement only sets (x, 0, z) and rotation.y.

nodes.label: Sub-graph Isolation & prune() Compression (scripts/prefabSlicer.ts)

nodes.rationale: Keeps Link 2 (Island 4 -> Island 2) unlocked whenever Tier 1 exceeds 4 questions and never locks synthetic links (10, 11) or downward links (5-9) so players can never become trapped on an upper island.

nodes.label: Namespaced QHMJ Progress, Zone Badges (>5) & SaveState.position.y
nodes.norm_label: namespaced qhmj progress, zone badges (>5) & savestate.position.y
nodes.rationale: Namespaces solvedProblems keys as qhmj_<zoneId>_<id> to avoid colliding with Flower/Park IDs 1..20, removes the zoneId <= 5 cap for zoneBadges, and persists optional position.y so multi-tier reload teleportation does not drop players onto Island 4.

nodes.label: 3-Source QHMJ Question Pipeline (Sheets, Apps Script, Fallback)
nodes.norm_label: 3-source qhmj question pipeline (sheets, apps script, fallback)
nodes.rationale: Falls back from Google Sheets QHMJ_Map (with optional PosY) to Apps Script ZONE_TEMPLATES.QHMJ_SANCTUARY to seeded client generateQhmjProblems() outputting standardized RemoteProblem steps (ADR 0013).

nodes.label: anchorQhmjProblemsToSurface 3D Placement
nodes.rationale: Anchors QhmjInteractiveNodes (jump_gate, path_crystal, clock_summit) onto RoadSurface using hasClearance(0.9), >=4.0m 3D exclusion from spawn/returnPortal, >=3.5m from jump targets, and sampleNearest() clamping for manual PosX/PosZ.

nodes.label: Deferred Spawn (ADR 0007) & Unloaded Map Dialog Fallbacks
nodes.norm_label: deferred spawn (adr 0007) & unloaded map dialog fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Resolves targetRegionId on launch to load only the saved region during #loading, and decouples openArchimedesMapDialog and #travel from unloaded 3D meshes via FLOWER_COORDS and computeProceduralEntityPositions.

nodes.label: Portal Loading Lifecycle & Anti-Flicker Transition
nodes.rationale: Replaces synchronous SpatialWorld teleport with onPortalTransitRequested -> paused input -> #loading paint yield (rAF) + 200-250ms anti-flicker -> ensureLoaded + compileAsync -> region swap -> teleport + error recovery.

nodes.label: Keep-Out Zones Spatial Clearance
nodes.rationale: Enforces >=3.5m clearance around Return Portal, >=2.2m around Knowledge Monoliths, and >=2.5m between large obstacles to guarantee unobstructed navigation and question interaction.

nodes.label: Portal Prefetch Metadata Fix (targetRegionKind)
nodes.rationale: Replaces brittle portalId substring checks (which failed to prefetch cozy_lake on hub_to_z1..z5 and erroneously preloaded 6.45MB park.glb on z*_to_village return portals) with explicit targetRegionKind metadata on PortalLink.
